xy_origin_note: The origin is the XY centre of the model's own bounding box, which sits on the surveyed OBB centre - the manifest anchor and what placeGeneric positions. The OSM polygon centroid and OBB centre agree to 0.07 m here, so the two candidate anchors coincide.
normal_orientation_method: Per-object signed volume is authoritative for this union of closed solids: every object must be manifold (each edge used twice) and enclose positive volume. 22,500 deterministic visibility rays run as a secondary check with a 0.15% residual tolerance.
